name: r3f-blob
title: 3D Shader Blob
description: A real-time 3D sculpture: a black blob whose noise-rippled surface keeps folding and bulging, lit by soft studio light on a black stage and leaning toward the pointer.
use: A dark hero or section needs a live, tactile centrepiece rather than a static illustration.
avoid: Low-power or mobile devices: continuous WebGL rendering and a remote HDR file add real cost.
a11y: Purely visual: no text, role or alt, and the perpetual warp ignores prefers-reduced-motion, so it cannot be paused or described to assistive tech. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single black, roughly spherical body fills the centre of a near-black stage. Its surface is heavily lumpy and folded like melted wax, lit from above so pale grey highlights catch the ridges while deep crevices stay in shadow.
behaves: The form keeps warping: noise displacement pushes its surface in and out each frame, and it drifts toward wherever the cursor moves. Moving the pointer over it increases the distortion and brightens the highlights.
customise: It is a self-contained scene with no props: intensity, colours, camera and the remote HDR environment are all set inside the source file.
weight: heavy: A full Three.js canvas renders a high-poly displaced shader mesh every frame, plus an HDRI.
